title: Tarot card data: all 78 cards (JSON and CSV)
description:
Structured data for the 78 tarot cards: names, numbers, suits, ranks, eight keywords each, upright and reversed meanings, yes or no answers, elements and astrology, plus an image of each card from the 1909 Rider-Waite-Smith deck (public domain). JSON and CSV, CC BY 4.0, no key, open CORS. From Taro's Tarot.

Always-current copies, field notes and an embeddable daily card: https://tarostarot.com/tarot-card-data

Credit line: Tarot card data by Taro's Tarot (CC BY 4.0). The card images are public domain.
